With huuuge speed, even a tiny pebble can send you flying in the air.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, Amelia gained a LOT of momentum in a very short time and then... Remember the pebble? Let's switch that pebble with an actual rock. That is the shortest description of what happened. But now I think I've recovered and I'll try to resume my normal schedule. For the sake of Steam Next Fest I unlocked some more stuff than usual.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for vanishing like that. notes.title: 🤐 Whisper before the Storm 🤐
notes.notes:
[h2](っ●'◡'●)っ 🦄 Status Update TL;DR 🦄[/h2]
Update #2 is cooking and is gonna be done THIS week. It's a big one. A special side-dish is also in the cooker. Go fill that google form if you want something added. Check Roadmap if you're curious what's coming. Sorry for the delay in responses. Thank you for being with me.

[h2](っ◔◡◔)っ 💬 My Blah Blah 💬[/h2]
[h3] ~ The price of the game and my stance about discounts ~ [/h3]
Some time ago, I really wanted a game. The game price was 35 bucks. And that was a lot for me at the time. But the game was really cool, and the developer was awesome. So I chipped in, got the game for full price. Even left a review because I heard this helps the game in some way. 

Two days after that, the game went on a custom sale and the price went down to $4.99. Was I scammed? No, of course. But it did make me feel like a loser T_T

I said to myself that if I ever, by any miracle, make a game, I will never spam discounts and maintain a reasonable margin for the few I will run.

[b]So the base price of Dreams of Amelia is $14.99. And will NEVER, ever go beyond -33%[/b]. Regardless of the platform. I cannot imagine weaving a bond with fans and followers if I juggle the prices up and down. I am aware I might be losing some chunk of revenue, but I have really tiny material needs, you know hehe. And I like things to be predictable. And I hope some of you will share the same sentiment. Sorry if I'll make someone angry, but I believe being transparent is worth more T_T

[h3] ~ Feature Request Form ~[/h3]
It came to my attention that a lot of you guys would like this or that in the game, but you don't want to stick your head out. Perfectly understandable. Even I am hush about some of my own fantasies *^-^*
Hence, I made a google form to fill in the blanks and secure your privacy a bit. Hope this helps ^.^
 ➡️ ➡️ [url=https://forms.gle/J9SKaVYZggeniJG79]Feature Request Form[/url] ⬅️ ⬅️

[h3] ~ Roadmap / Development Plan ~ [/h3]
I posted it right away after I released the game on Itch, but then I forgot I never linked it anywhere XD
So here you have it at last!
➡️ ➡️ [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/122ynZ1TXgRkZX4HmvVQelAEdDh14bRn-_NaE9UC1V9A/edit?usp=sharing]Roadmap Google Doc[/url] ⬅️ ⬅️

[h3] ~ Personal Share ~ [/h3]
I am [b]stunlocked[/b] how fast Amelia is gaining speed, and I start to worry, do I really deserve the attention, and am I up to task ._.

I am not saying that for you to come and say "there there". No. I am honestly worried. As I said many times by now, I came in with no expectations. No, scratch that. I did actually come with [i]some[/i].

I expected ppl will boo me out of the milky way, I'll get depressed, put this entire game making on the pile with all my other broken dreams, then I will proceed being depressed for couple of months and then I will get over it and reverse back to my usual generic NPC mode. 

But then this happened. [b]You happen[/b]. And for some reason, you won't let me go. You stick to me like a warm blanket, covering me in a [b]cocoon of happy[/b]. And for the first time in my life, I feel I am worth something.

I do not know if my game will fulfil your dreams and hopes. But I know that I will do everything in my power, drain all my resources, to provide you with the best I am capable of.

Time will tell if my "[i]everything[/i]", has been "[i]enough[/i]".

Thank you! And see you soon by the weekend. I prepared lots of goodies for you, my dear :-)
[i]~Laura[/i]

📢 INFO | To celebrate Steam Demo release & first update, I'm unlocking one more Lewd Position and a color in the Demo. 

[h1](っ◔◡◔)っ 💬 My Blah Blah 💬[/h1]
There is soooo much I want to say right now. But I am trying to figure out how to express all those thoughts so they do not become like a book, hm.
Thank you. Yeah. It all boils down to... Thank you. 
Thank you, my thousands of visitors who strayed nearby.
Thank you, my hundreds of Wishlisting fellows.
Thank you, my dozens of followers.
Thank you, with all of my heart strength. 

Thank you for all the comments, all the likes and subs, all the follows, all the upvotes, every big and every small thing. For every suggestion and every opinion. For every warm smile and every word of critique. I know, I am self-aware enough to understand how cringe all of this is coming out. XD

But you have to understand. A week ago, no one knew about me or Amelia. A week ago, I was your friendly NPC, you just passed by on the street walk. I was making Dreams of Amelia, fully prepared that there are huge chances I will simply bounce off the harsh reality. I was expecting many things.

But never, even for a brief moment, would I dare to think I'll be met with so much warmth, friendship, and support.  I salute you. And I will repay the trust and faith you put in me by making Amelia as great as possible. I am giving my all. 

Of course, reality check click click! - I still have a regular job. So the development of the game still takes time between my working and sleeping hours :P

But now I know I am not wasting time. And that, someone is waiting for me.
No one ever anticipated anything from me. 

So one more time...
Thank you.

notes.title: Let it be Lewd!
notes.notes:
​Hello everyone! :D

So... mmm. Geez I'm exhausted D: Sorry.  

Ok, let's try again. So, some time ago I started making games. And they all sucked badly lol. But I learned a lot on the way. And I've spent the past half a year making Dreams of Amelia. My goal was to create an ergogame that is both lewd AF but... cozy. Not too complex, sandboxy. Lets call it Horny Safe Place XD At least, that is/was my goal. But of course, my dear reader,  the result of my hard work is for you to judge.

The current playable build is an alpha version. I tried hammering down everything I could spot, but I am aware I might have missed quite a few bugs and what not. Also, sorry for the lack of content. My aim is set quite high, and if this picks up a bit I would like to add more positions, toys, hair styles, locations, dress and clothing, more customisation, controller support (which I codemed "One Hand Mode" XD ), Virtual Reality (both wired and wireless), mobile version and to actually write some non-lewd interactions, story and dialogues.... and more!

The thing is... I am dirt-poor XD (hence, you don't need to worry, am I using AI - I can't afford stuff like that D':), I have a "meh" IRL job, so I am making the game after work or when I have free time. So the speed of the development might be slow. Sowwy T_T

Anyway, wow what a wall of text! Please feel invited to play the game or the demo, share your opinion, feedback, suggestion or anything you like really. I am most active on my discord server and this is where you can get my attention in real time. Of course, I also will be checking all other places. Just umm, I hope for your patience because this is really a lot of work for one person D: 

Hope to hear your mind soon :)

Have a wonderful day!
~Laura
